study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Jing et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2023
study_identification_part.si4_title: Heterogeneous brain dynamic functional connectivity patterns in first-episode drug-naive patients with major depressive disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Identify heterogenous subtypes within first-episode drug-naive major depressive disorder (FEDN-MDD) by applying a multivariate unsupervised normative modeling approach to dynamic functional connectivity features, and compare clinical and structural characteristics across subtypes.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Two FEDN-MDD subtypes showed distinct dynamic functional connectivity and gray matter deviation patterns; subtype I exhibited larger extreme deviations and shorter illness duration, whereas subtype II showed weaker deviations with longer illness duration.
